reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it is presented as a broadcast report about alleged pornographic-site call centers and an NBI raid, with the operators' conduct attributed to the reported operation rather than promoted to viewers. The request to subscribe to the news channel is ordinary audience engagement, and the described material does not establish client deception, unauthorized payment, or a creator solicitation of the reported activity.

citations.quote: Porn site peddlers caught in Call Centers
The NBA has been raiding the two separate call centers in Quezon City which are also selling pornographic sites to clients from other countries.
They also arrested eight men
The group is also to find out if the client credit card is hacked.
They create profiles through Facebook and various email accounts. And then they enter and greet online chat rooms and claim they are models.

opening.argument: The reported conduct contains a concrete pay-for-access pathway: operators allegedly posed as models, directed a contacted client to links, and then charged him when he signed up. That is not merely discussion of adult content; it is an identity-based solicitation tied to a payment-producing action. The commission description further connects each sale to the operators’ financial incentive. Read together, the evidence supports treating the featured activity as a scam-like acquisition scheme, even if the broadcast presents it as reporting.

citations.quote: They create profiles through Facebook and various email accounts. And then they enter and greet online chat rooms and claim they are models.
So once they triediced the client, they had the links to introduce him to her. There will be a client being charged. They will just sign up.
Like the porn site, it is on the commission basis so like for a hundred or per sale

rebuttal.rebuttal: A raid and arrests establish that authorities acted; they do not establish that the underlying customer-facing conduct was legitimate. Likewise, calling the material a report does not negate the described mechanism: fabricated model identities, links, sign-up, and a charge. The evidence therefore supports examining the solicitation itself, not just the broadcaster’s tone.

citations.quote: The NBA has been raiding the two separate call centers in Quezon City which are also selling pornographic sites to clients from other countries.
They also arrested eight men

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted sequence describes alleged third-party conduct, not a viewer-directed offer by this video. It does not show that the broadcaster created the profiles, sent the links, charged a viewer, or invited anyone to sign up. The surrounding description instead identifies the channel and offers ordinary news-subscription information, so the payment pathway cannot be attributed to the video itself.

citations.quote: Porn site peddlers caught in Call Centers
Subscribe to the ABSCBNNews channel!
They create profiles through Facebook and various email accounts.

opening.argument: Several red flags reinforce one another: anonymous-looking Facebook and email profiles, people claiming to be models, links introduced after contact, charges for sign-up, and commissions that increase with foreign client volume. That combination is materially more concerning than a plainly disclosed sale. The payment incentive is explicit, while the identity and destination are presented through impersonation-like claims and external links. A careful judge can therefore regard the featured operation as deceptive customer acquisition rather than ordinary entertainment commerce.

citations.quote: They create profiles through Facebook and various email accounts. And then they enter and greet online chat rooms and claim they are models.
So once they triediced the client, they had the links to introduce him to her.
They usually have a commission of 500. And if there are many clients who sign in to be foreigners, we will be able to charge them for more.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense emphasizes the report’s investigative setting, but that setting is compatible with the report exposing precisely these red flags. The statement that authorities were checking whether client credit cards were hacked adds a further unresolved payment-risk concern; it does not clear the operation. Nor does a news label explain away false model claims and commission-driven links.

citations.quote: The group is also to find out if the client credit card is hacked.
they enter and greet online chat rooms and claim they are models

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are allegations reported in an investigation, not proof that the video itself makes a deceptive offer. The sources do not establish that any card was hacked, that the links were fraudulent, or that the channel solicited payment. A commission and a sign-up charge may describe the reported business model, but they do not by themselves prove deception by the publisher.

citations.quote: The group is also to find out if the client credit card is hacked.
They usually have a commission of 500.

opening.argument: Although packaged as news, the segment supplies a usable promotional narrative for the operation: it explains how supposed models are presented, how contacts are moved to links, how clients sign up, and how sellers earn per sale. Repeating that funnel can function as promotion or instruction even when the headline says people were caught. The description also directs viewers to subscribe and visit external sites, giving the package an audience-acquisition layer. On the available evidence, the news framing does not eliminate the scam-like solicitation being displayed.

citations.quote: Porn site peddlers caught in Call Centers
They create profiles through Facebook and various email accounts. And then they enter and greet online chat rooms and claim they are models.
So once they triediced the client, they had the links to introduce him to her. There will be a client being charged.
Visit our website at http://www.abs-cbnnews.com

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the segment a broadcast report answers who is speaking, not what conduct the segment describes. The headline’s word “peddlers” and the account of links, charges, and commissions can equally be read as a warning label attached to a demonstrated sales funnel. A viewer need not be directly told to join for the segment to make the pathway salient.

citations.quote: Porn site peddlers caught in Call Centers
There will be a client being charged. They will just sign up.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The title explicitly says the peddlers were caught, which signals condemnation rather than endorsement. The external URL is the broadcaster’s website, and the description asks viewers to subscribe to the news channel; neither is a link to the reported call centers or their porn sites. Explaining alleged conduct in a report does not convert it into a solicitation by the publisher.
